title: Multi-Instance Security for CTR-DRBG
summary: Distinct nonces permit multiple CTR-DRBG instances to share a randomness source, but existing analysis omits multi-instance security; establishing the corresponding theorem remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Establish a multi-instance security theorem for CTR-DRBG when multiple generator instances share the same randomness source but receive distinct nonces through the optional nonce inputs to setup and refresh. Existing analysis does not cover this multi-instance setting, although distinct nonces permit multiple CTR-DRBG instances to use a common randomness source.

scope.domain: Multi-instance security analysis of CTR-DRBG with a shared randomness source.
parameters: Multiple generator instances: the instances whose joint security is to be analyzed
Setup and refresh nonces: optional inputs that are distinct across instances and permit a common randomness source
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish a security theorem covering multiple CTR-DRBG instances that share the randomness source while using distinct setup and refresh nonces.

progress.summary: The source explains that setup and refresh may accept nonces, enabling multiple CTR-DRBG instances to use one randomness source when their nonces differ. It explicitly states that the work does not consider multi-instance security.
citation_labels: Viet Tung Hoang et al., Security Analysis of NIST CTR-DRBG
